title: Peter & Gwen — Faahun
topic: The Amazing Spider-Man: Peter Parker and Gwen Stacy · Bangla metal (Sharani Shamman)
thesis: The line is a corpse's arithmetic: you are the reason I died, and you are the reason I am still alive. That is the Gwen story told from inside it — the dark half of the pack, the fall, the silence after.

audience.claim: Every high-performing Peter/Gwen edit is loss, not romance: 'I lost Gwen, she was my MJ' out-performs every swinging cut in the fandom.
audience.source: TikTok discover pages for Peter/Gwen, top items 222K-896K likes

audience.claim: The frame that breaks containment is the fall and the web that misses — the moment the audience already knows is coming.
audience.source: Viral 'flips and Gwen' edit, 15M views / 720K likes

audience.claim: Bangla metal edits travel on the lyric, not the action: the hook is quoted in the caption and the cut is slow. Fast cuts read as a different genre.
audience.source: Bangla edit pages: Sharani Shamman / Faahun tags, comment threads

lyric.why: her, and what loving her cost
the same face, the reason he is still here

avoid: the two Twixtor title cards (#0 and #63) — burned-in text
any fast montage: this is a metal lyric, the cut is a held image
shots where she is cropped out of frame
hooks: you were the reason i died
and the reason i'm still alive
she is both the wound and the cure
